mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.place, c.day_of_week, c.capacity, c.num_of_student, c.status, c.time, p.id AS professor_id, u.name AS professor_name, s.name AS subject_name, sem.name AS semester_name, s.credit FROM course c JOIN subject s ON c.subject_id = s.id JOIN professor p ON c.professor_id = p.id JOIN semester sem ON c.semester_id = sem.id JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.place, c.day_of_week, c.capacity, c.status, c.num_of_student, c.time, s.name AS subject_name, s.credit, p.id AS professor_id, u.name AS professor_name, sem.name AS semester_name FROM course c JOIN subject s ON c.subject_id = s.id JOIN professor p ON c.professor_id = p.id JOIN semester sem ON c.semester_id = sem.id JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT s.credit FROM course c JOIN subject s ON c.subject_id = s.id WHERE c.id = #{courseId}
SELECT id, professor_id, subject_id, semester_id, capacity, num_of_student, day_of_week, place, status, time FROM course WHERE id = #{id}
